name: cloudbake
description: Render Blender scenes on cloud GPUs with CloudBake from Codex: send a .blend from your project, and the frames come back into it. Converts to .glb, .fbx and .usdz too.

interface.shortDescription: Render Blender scenes on cloud GPUs
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to render frames of a .blend in your project. The file goes to CloudBake, a cloud GPU renders it, and the frames are saved back into the project. It also makes an MP4 of a render and converts scenes to .glb, .fbx and .usdz. GPU time is paid from your CloudBake credit; Codex renders one test frame first and says what the whole job would cost.
defaultPrompt: Render frame 1 of the CloudBake sample scene and show it to me.
Render frames 1-24 of scene.blend with CloudBake into renders/.
Make an MP4 of my last CloudBake render.
